== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Source used: [http://www.swccgpc.com/news/news.php?id=57 Worlds 2K Event – Penn. March 27-29, 09 – From Chris Fanchi] (2 April 2009; already cited as pc-news57; [https://web.archive.org/web/20090413053951/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=57 Internet Archive]): team sealed deck rules, seeds and mugs; Fanchi 5th and Mike Richards 15th (third alternate) after Day 1; Day 1 meta; Fanchi's decks.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* Fanchi's thanks to [[Joe Young]] and [[Kim Caton]] (lodging) and [[Bill Kafer]] (airport pickup) were left out as personal trip details.
* The 2 April 2009 news item "Worlds 2000 post event discussion" ([https://web.archive.org/web/20090413055357/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/news/news.php?id=56 Internet Archive]) is only a link to a forum thread that was not preserved, so it was not added.
* Fanchi also mentions Bring Him Before Me decks; the report does not say how common they were, so only Ralltiir Operations and Mind What You Have Learned are described as common.

== Forum (forum.starwarsccg.org) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Sources used: the forum board [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewforum.php?f=386 2009 Players Championship (Past Event)] (all 24 topics read, each one page), especially [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=24994 Worlds 2000 FAQ] (t=24994; [https://web.archive.org/web/20210126111807/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=24994 Internet Archive]), t=24987 (format), t=25004 (pre-registration), t=25067 (Tournament Director), t=25346 (legal sets), t=25807 (Event Schedule), t=26403, t=26553 (Top 12 for day 2), t=26558 (finals), t=26608 (uh, results?). Added: weekend name, organizer, tournament director, venue, schedule of the three events, prizes and card rules, 3rd place in the team event, final Day 2 standings, final game.
The forum user Advocate (quoted on the forum as CRingwell) is [[Scott Lingrell]]; the 2008 swccgpc.com Volunteer Information lists "Scott Lingrell / CRingwell". The user kcaton is [[Kim Caton]], Dalton is [[Michael Dalton]], and "Chris Twigg" in the forum posts is [[Chris Terwilliger]].
=== Missing data ===
* Places 5th and 7th to 11th on Day 2: Kim Caton's list (t=26608, 31 March 2009) gives Scott Diehl 5th, Steven Lewis 7th, Matt Sokol 8th, Chris Terwilliger 9th, David Lankton 10th and Tom Hollingworth 11th, each with a question mark, and says "I'm sure Scott will clarify tomorrow". No later post in the board gives the official standings, so those places are blank in the table.
* The consolation event's entrants (other than its winner, [[Mike Richards]]) and the number of team-event entrants are not posted. [[Michael Dalton]] wrote that he "enjoyed all 3 events"; no row was added for him in the consolation.
* [[Jonny Chu]] "will provide tournament support as well" (t=25067, 27 January 2009). No post shows what he did at the event, and on 29 March he posted second-hand news ("I hear ..."), so no Service row was added.
* The pre-registration list (t=25004) also names Pete Flamini, Robb Webb, Eric George and Max Bouchard, who have no Day 1 decklist; it is not known whether they played.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* The forum post and news item give 40 players, but the Day 1 PDF has decklists for 41 players.
* The FAQ (12 January 2009) says the top 8 move to Day 2; the same day the organizer changed it to the top 12 (t=24987), which is what was played.
* [[Hayes Hunter]]'s page gives his Day 2 finish as "Finalist"; the forum standings give 1st. Left unchanged.
[[User:Holocron Claude|Holocron Claude]] ([[User talk:Holocron Claude|talk]]) 13:20, 24 November 2026 (UTC)
